title: Knowledge Relation Schema V1
description: Canonical schema for relations between Knowledge Objects in the Knowledge-Memory Authority system.

source_id.description: Object ID of the source node (origin of the relation).

target_id.description: Object ID of the target node (destination of the relation).

mission_id.description: Mission scope for this relation. Null for cross-mission relations.

confidence.description: Confidence in this relation. 1.0 = explicitly asserted. <1.0 = inferred.

evidence_id.description: Evidence artifact ID that supports this relation.

bidirectional.description: Whether the relation is symmetric (A relates to B implies B relates to A).

weight.description: Relation strength for graph traversal and ranking.
